question: The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will be held in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027** is officially set to be hosted by **Brazil**. This landmark decision was announced during the **74th FIFA Congress** held in **Bangkok**, **Thailand**, on **May 17, 2024**.
 
• **Brazil** won the hosting rights through an open vote, receiving **119 votes** from the **FIFA** member associations, surpassing the joint bid from **Belgium**, **Germany**, and the **Netherlands**, which received **78 votes**.
